page_title: TOR 1-0 GEN | Torino v Genoa 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' 10:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+4' 1 - 0 GOAL! Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) finds the back of the net from close in from a very acute angle.
90+3' Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a smart save to deny him.
90+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Mattia Bani (Genoa). Daniele Chiffi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milan Badelj leaves the pitch and Silvan Hefti (Genoa) comes on.
87' Here is a change. Stefano Sabelli is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Martin (Genoa).
84' Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
82' A substitution has been made. Raoul Bellanova goes off and Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes on.
81' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a chip pass into the box, but Josep Martinez is quickest to intercept the ball.
78' Yellow card. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pietro Pellegri (Torino) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Karol Linetty is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
74' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) on for Mateo Retegui.
73' The referee blows for a cooling break.
72' Genoa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
71' Today's referee Daniele Chiffi rightly decides to book Demba Seck (Torino) for his harsh tackle.
68' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
66' The Torino players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
64' Here's the change. Duvan Zapata leaves the pitch and Pietro Pellegri (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
64' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Nikola Vlasic will be replaced by Nemanja Radonjic (Torino).
64' It will be a substitution. Demba Seck (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Adrien Tameze walks off.
63' Genoa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
57' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) replacing Ruslan Malinovsky.
57' Today's match ends for Kevin Strootman who will be replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
55' Wasted effort! Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
55' Torino will take a free kick.
52' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) tries to find Nikola Vlasic, but he puts too much power on the pass.
49' A clever short pass gives Raoul Bellanova (Torino) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Genoa was in an offside position.
45+3' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+1' The main referee, Daniele Chiffi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is given a yellow card for dissent.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Samuele Ricci (Torino) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Josep Martinez expertly pushes away.
44' Josep Martinez (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' A player from Torino commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
42' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle after Raoul Bellanova (Torino) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
42' A cross from Raoul Bellanova (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
35' Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.
34' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' Torino concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
31' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is caught offside!
30' Karol Linetty (Torino) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
27' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
27' The game is interrupted now, Josep Martinez (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
21' The referee blows his whistle as Samuele Ricci (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge.
19' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Chiffi ignores the protests.
18' Milan Badelj (Genoa) brings his opponent down. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Torino are awarded a free kick.
16' Perr Schuurs (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' The Torino players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
7' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Torino have a corner.
4' Torino are ruled offside.

The players are out at last! Torino will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Chiffi.
